ZAF.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
Document covers AI training for public servants, not an AI system in use in administration.
Document states no AI tool in a sector's public system.
Document states no AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: The Department of Public Service and Administration reports that the National School of Government and Microsoft South Africa signed a memorandum of agreement aiming to train 100,000 public servants in digital literacy, AI and cybersecurity on NSG Learner Management Platforms.

ZAF.note: Only Microsoft's own pledge to train one million people is mentioned; no government programme for the public or measured share.
Document says nothing on schools or curriculum.
